rationale: The flag is an aggregate fill-rate issue for direct-lending rate extraction. The source schedule has coupon rates for the four corporate bond rows cited above, but the bundle's extracted holdings slice shows blank interest_rate for those same four private-credit positions. Current-period schedule totals tie to 45,918,606, so this is not an anchor problem; it is a localized extraction gap for coupons embedded in the portfolio-company text rather than the Interest Rate column.
